questions.q: Working in groups helps students build ______.
questions.passage: Last week our teacher asked us to work in groups. At first, I wasn't sure how it would go, but it turned out great! We shared ideas, helped each other, and finished our project faster. Learning together taught me the value of teamwork and cooperation. When one of us didn't understand something, someone else explained it clearly. It felt good to give and receive help. We also became more confident. Group work helped us think of creative ways to solve problems and learn new skills.
